title: Resuming Vision-Language Inference across Onboard Interruptions
abstract: arXiv:2610.29183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Executing vision-language models (VLMs) aboard low-Earth orbit satellites enables flexible processing of observation data without first downlinking it to the ground. On commercial off-the-shelf payloads, however, a request may span multiple execution windows: power and thermal constraints, fault-triggered reboots, and competing payload demands can interrupt inference before it completes. Each shutdown discards volatile activations and KV caches, forcing an unprotected request to repeat work after restart.   We present OrbitWeaver, a framework that preserves VLM inference progress across onboard interruptions through coordinated checkpointing and recovery. Its phase-aware checkpointing selects recovery boundaries according to the state lifetimes and computational characteristics of vision encoding, language-model prefill, and decoding, balancing storage traffic against recomputation. translated_title: 跨越星载中断的视觉-语言模型推理恢复
translated_abstract: 在近地轨道卫星上执行视觉-语言模型，可以灵活处理观测数据，而无需先将数据下传到地面。然而，在商用现货载荷上，一个请求可能跨越多个执行窗口：电源与热约束、故障触发的重启以及相互竞争的载荷需求都可能在推理完成前将其中断。每次关机都会丢弃易失性的激活值和KV缓存，迫使未受保护的请求在重启后重复已完成的工作。我们提出了OrbitWeaver，一个通过协同的检查点与恢复机制、在星载中断间保留视觉-语言模型推理进展的框架。其阶段感知的检查点机制根据视觉编码、语言模型预填充和解码的状态生命周期与计算特性来选择恢复边界，在存储流量与重计算之间取得平衡。其依赖感知的动态恢复机制调度恢复（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出OrbitWeaver框架，通过阶段感知的检查点与依赖感知的恢复机制，使视觉-语言模型在卫星因断电、重启等原因中断后能够保存并恢复推理进度，避免重复计算。
en_tdlr: OrbitWeaver enables vision-language model inference aboard satellites to survive onboard interruptions such as power cuts and reboots through phase-aware checkpointing and dependency-aware recovery, preserving progress and avoiding redundant recomputation.
